title: Parakou zemidjan drivers gather over police treatment of a detained colleague and alleged extortion
location: Outside the Direction Départementale de la Police Républicaine, Parakou
scope: One reported gathering by zemidjan motorcycle-taxi drivers on 26 June; available account does not establish duration or attendance.
organizer: Zemidjan drivers; no named organizer identified.
participants_original: No count reported; article refers qualitatively to a gathering and a 'yellow wave' (one outlet).
threshold_50_evidence: Pending. The one opened local report describes a group/movement of drivers but provides no number or clearly countable equivalent; do not infer >=50 from plural or metaphor.

start_date.summary: Daabaaru dates the gathering to Monday 26 June 2023.

location.summary: The report places the drivers in front of the departmental Republican Police directorate in Parakou.

organizer.summary: The report identifies the participants as zemidjan drivers (motorcycle taxi drivers), but names no organizer.

demands.summary: The article says participants sought information about a colleague detained after a road crash and complained of police extortion and excessive detentions.

participants_original.summary: The article uses group/movement language but gives no attendance number.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No numerical attendance or clear size comparison in this single opened report; >=50 remains unresolved.

protester_violence.summary: unknown; the opened account does not report violence by the drivers.

state_response.summary: Daabaaru says police used tear gas to disperse the gathering; no event-specific arrest, beating, killing or shooting information.

notes: Public action directed at conduct of the Beninese Republican Police, a state institution; attendance threshold is unresolved and only one account is presently opened. No independence or corroboration claim.
open_questions: Is there another contemporaneous account giving attendance or a clearer scale description?
Did police arrest or injure participants beyond using tear gas?
Was there any accommodation or direct official response?
